scope: BCM kernel7 PSI backport ABI review; no hardware actions, SL1680 changes or commits

stock_layout_evidence.provenance: Compile-only layout object built from stock config/headers, not debug info from proprietary blobs

existing_layouts.rq: No full rq in stored header-probe DWARF; preserve source structure or add a scheduler-specific probe

psi_flags.placement: Existing alignment hole between pagefault_disabled at1904 and oom_reaper_list at1912; keep unchanged

task_abi.recommended_in_memstall: Append after all existing fields in this word under CONFIG_PSI (bit5 with tested config); never insert at the upstream in_iowait location. Compare DWARF bit_offset/bit_size, as offsetof cannot inspect C bitfields.
compile_guards: Existing kernel/gtbe98_cgroup_abi.h validates old non-bitfield task members and scheduler/block layouts

cgroup_abi.reason: Stock CONFIG_CGROUPS is disabled; saved stock-config probe has no complete cgroup/cftype. Kernel6 already changed cgroup/css_set/cgroup_root relative to kernel5 by adding controllers.
cgroup_abi.recommended_design: Keep struct cgroup unchanged; allocate aligned psi_group storage after the dynamically sized ancestor_ids tail. A constant-time helper derives its address. Preserve 856-byte cgroup base and every old member offset.
allocation_requirements: Use identical ALIGN expression for allocator and accessor; include level+1 ancestor IDs and overflow-safe size arithmetic
Root cgroups are embedded in cgroup_root; return psi_system for supported root PSI instead of computing a tail address into cgroup_root fields
Keep PSI alloc/free error unwinding and per-CPU/worker lifetime matched; free all pressure triggers before freeing group storage

implemented_kernfs_poll.design: Init-only single poll hook identified by the existing ops->open function. No struct expansion. Copied cgroup ops match because kmemdup preserves open. Function pointers are read-only after init; APIs are not exported to modules.
implemented_kernfs_poll.registration: kernfs_register_poll(cgroup_file_open, cgroup_file_poll) in cgroup_init before publishing files; caller must check return
implemented_kernfs_poll.generic_poll: kernfs_generic_poll(of, wait) uses the kernfs open-node waitqueue whose lifetime matches the file, avoiding cgroup PSI trigger waitqueue lifetime mismatch
implemented_kernfs_poll.locking: fop_poll locks of->mutex before active reference, mirroring read/write lock ordering. All existing of-based active-acquisition paths now reject already-released files after acquiring active, excluding concurrent drain.

reproduce_abi.compiler_argv: build/candidate-layout/command.json; replace input and output with unique PSI probe/object paths; retain -g -gdwarf-4 -fno-eliminate-unused-debug-types
reproduce_abi.probe: build/resource6/probe.c includes task/mm/network/block/user namespace definitions; append kernel/gtbe98_cgroup_abi.h and call its guard for compile-time checks
reproduce_abi.comparison: Compare every baseline member by name, offset, bytes, bit_size and bit_offset, plus aggregate size; added private PSI types are allowed but old kernfs/task/network/block fields must not move.

remaining_gate: Main agent must integrate fixed upstream PSI, compile whole kernel, run live cgroup migration/pressure/trigger/close/delete/regression QEMU tests, and retain no-commit trial policy for any later hardware test.
